# Foam bed liner installation and storage

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Acquire, lay down back seats, place foam, mark wheel wells, cut sections, then test fit by lying down. [t1668]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Acquire a foam bed insert that is thick enough for comfort but thin enough to roll up for efficient storage.
2. Lay down the back seats inside the truck bed.
3. Place the foam bed on top of the folded rear seats.
4. [Partial] Mark the locations where the wheel wells cut into the foam and note its overall height.
5. Cut away sections of the foam around the marked wheel well areas to create room for cargo like drinks or phones.
6. Test fit by lying down in the finished bed configuration.

_Procedure reported by [t1668]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-foam-bed.3173/>_

## Tools

- Sharp utensil (knife, scissors, saw, etc.) [t1668]

## Parts

- Foam bed insert: Brand new or used; 4 inches thick mentioned as an example [t1668]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Fold the foam in half 'hot dog style' and roll it up for storage if space is tight. [t1668]
- [Partial] Use a waterproof sleeping bag to store the rolled-up bed on the roof rack. [t1668]
